prompts.positive_en: Direct-flash digital editorial photograph of a young ceramicist in a clay-dusted canvas apron holding a small glazed vase at chest height, neutral expression with direct gaze into the lens, centered waist-up medium shot against a flat warm-beige gallery wall, natural perspective with deep flash-frozen focus, face and vase tack-sharp, a faint hard-edged shadow thrown onto the wall behind, hard frontal on-camera flash with a small hotspot sheen on the forehead and round flash catchlights, neutral flash-balanced grade with warm amber skin, restrained neutrals and one saturated glazed accent, visible skin pores, coarse canvas apron weave, matte drywall grain, ultra-fine digital grain with dust specks, clean dry air, contemporary candid intimacy, generous wall negative space, snapshot-frozen instant.
prompts.positive_zh: 机顶闪光灯直闪的数字编辑摄影，一名年轻陶艺人穿着沾有陶土的帆布围裙，胸前捧着一只小釉面陶瓶，神情平静直视镜头，居中腰上中景，背景是一面平坦的暖米色画廊墙铺满画幅边缘，自然透视，闪光冻结的深景深，面部与陶瓶锐利清晰，身后墙上投下淡淡的硬边阴影，硬质正面闪光，额头带小面积高光热点，圆形闪光眼神光，中性闪光平衡调色配暖琥珀色肤色，克制的中性色中只有陶瓶一处饱和点缀色，可见皮肤毛孔、粗帆布围裙纹理、哑光石膏墙颗粒，极细数字颗粒带灰尘点，干燥干净的室内空气，当代抓拍亲密感，大面积墙面留白，快照冻结的瞬间。
